binding.message: bound to R2-01 PASS run bb6d8ca34dbc4537a43d54be30c9f3e1 (candidate_status=CANDIDATE), R2-04 PASS run cd2b58b019314fafb90304234e6d1907, and R2-05 PASS run da82e15b61c94019840477642618565a; trace identity re-verified byte-identical on disk.

reasons: R2-01 PASS and R2-05 PASS verified; trace identity re-verified byte-identical on disk; expert identity treated layer-locally throughout; transition counts reconciled exactly against an independently-coded second computation; conditional probability mass per source expert sums to 1.0 within tolerance; the minimum transition support threshold was predeclared before this run and applied only to headline/strong-transition summaries, never to raw per-cell evidence; two independent syntheses over the identical trace, identical R2-05 bridge evidence, and identical null-baseline seed/config produced an identical canonical digest; no forbidden claim (predictor accuracy, reuse distance, temporal drift, cross-layer primary evidence, assumed self-transition dominance) was generated.
scope: offline DESCRIPTIVE CHARACTERIZATION of SAME-LAYER token-to-token expert-routing transition structure on the validated R2-01 trace -- no new replay, no model/runtime invocation, no new trace capture, no predictor, no accuracy claim, no reuse-distance or temporal-drift measurement, no cross-layer primary claim
transition_unit: One counted transition observation = one (source_expert_id, target_expert_id) pair contributed by one pair of CONSECUTIVE entries yielded by Trace.token_selections(layer, phase) for one layer (token-to-token, SAME layer; 'consecutive' = consecutive in the iterator's own yielded order, not consecutive token_index). Multi-expert selections are expanded via pairwise set-to-set counting: every expert i in the source selection paired with every expert j in the target selection, each pair counted once with weight 1 (never deduplicated). Cross-layer transitions are excluded from this unit entirely; layer visitation order is architectural, not a routing-structure transition.
